visualCharacteristics.purpose: Data table with a header row
visualCharacteristics.description: Red (#e81b2b) header row with white bold labels, zebra-striped light-grey body rows, thin #ddd cell borders, 14-15px text; scrolls horizontally on narrow screens (3+ columns keep a 540px minimum width). A screen-reader caption repeats the nearest heading above the block.

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = column headers, rows 2..N = data rows; 2-4 cells per row (rich text: em, sup, links). Columns empty in every row are dropped

reuseGuidance: Use for plain tabular data with a header row (up to 4 columns). Use table-grouped for headerless name | description lists grouped by label rows.
